messages:
sofia: Quick RFC follow-up: proposing a precision-thermostat that escalates FP8/INT8 -> FP16 for short-lived quality spikes. Here's a rough operational model.
raj: Nice. What inputs trigger an escalation? token confidence? embedding drift? latency?
eva: Also worried about cache and batch stability if we flip precision mid-request.
maddie: Exactly  we need safeguards to avoid cache key collisions and extreme cache churn.
sofia: Plan: two signals. 1) Fast token-level detector (snr, repeat tokens, softmax gap) -> temporary escalation for M tokens. 2) Slow evaluator (sampled eval metrics per-endpoint) -> bump the default profile if consistent.
liam: How many tokens for the temp bump? 8? 32?
sofia: Default M = 12, but configurable per-endpoint. Use exponential decay so it naturally cools.
raj: How do we communicate this without extra RPCs?
sofia: The runtime adds a tiny routing hint header: `x-prec-hint: escalate=fp8->fp16;ttl=12;score=0.82;scope=range:120-180` so the router picks a host with a matching capable profile.
maddie: scope is important. For long docs we shouldn't escalate the entire context because of a local glitch. Range-scoped hints solve that.
liam: If the router routes to a host with FP16, caching formats differ. We should namespace reheated entries and set short TTLs.
eva: Agree. Suggest cache keys like `rehash|ep|profile|v2|ctxid|range` and 20s TTL. Also log cache put/drop rates.
sofia: Telemetry: sample ~0.5% of reheated requests and send a compact delta metric (embedding cosine diff + simple token edit distance) into Optimize. If the delta exceeds a threshold we queue a profile review.
raj: Ops controls? per-customer escalation budget, global kill-switch, and rate limits per-endpoint.
maddie: Add dashboards: reheats/min, cost delta per-1000 tokens, cache churn. Also an alert when reheats increase >x% week-over-week.
liam: Tests: synthetic oscillation harness, cache-isolation unit tests, router-tier-respect tests (don't fall back to reserved GPUs unless SLA).
sofia: Example config snippet for ops:
```
precision_thermostat:
  enabled: true
  temp_escalation_tokens: 12
  escalation_ttl_secs: 30
  sample_rate_optimize: 0.005
  score_threshold: 0.8
  fallback_profile: fp16
  cache_reheat_ttl_s: 20
  per_customer_budget_tokens: 100000
```
infra-bot: deploy:staging started for `precision-thermostat:v0.1` in us-central-1.
sofia: Rollout plan: 1) shadow mode (record hints but don't change routing) 2 weeks, 2) gradual enable for non-critical endpoints 3) enable per-customer with opt-out flag.
raj: Action items:
- raj: prototype router hint parser + tier-aware allocator (due Thu)
- maddie: dashboards + ops runbook + emergency kill-switch (due Mon)
- liam: unit + integration tests for cache namespace and range scope (due next Wed)
- eva: design synthetic oscillation suite and run short baseline (due Fri)
- sofia: add thermostat section to RFC and add telemetry export to Optimize (due Fri)
maddie: +1 on timeline. Shadowing for 2 weeks sounds right.
sofia: If no objections, I'll fold these notes into the RFC and push a staging canary today. Thanks all.
eva: :thumbsup:
sofia: tagging @infra to watch staging deploy metrics, please ping if we see unusual cache churn.
